notes:
Summary: Jurisync LexSearch is building an enterprise RAG layer for corporate legal & compliance customers (internal investigations, litigation holds, contract review). Key constraints: all indexes must be inside customer VPC or on-prem; 7+ year retention + immutable audit trail per case; strict data residency for EU clients.

Indexing & scale: initial corpus = ~30M documents (legacy doc store + emails + eDiscovery exports), target growth to ~120M over 12–18 months. Average doc size variable; estimate ~4–6TB raw, embeddings storage (sparse + quantized) expected to be significant. They plan weekly ingests and occasional bulk re-indexes during litigation events.

Performance SLOs / targets: vector retrieval p95 <= 200ms, end-to-end RAG (retrieve + rerank + LLM pass) <= 800ms for short-answer flows; heavier summarization flows can be multi-second. Peak query patterns: steady 150–300 qps with nightly spikes up to 1.5k qps during discovery crunch windows. Cost sensitivity: target blended cost-per-query <= $0.005 for standard retrieval flows; willing to pay more for high-value juror-ready outputs.

Architecture preferences discussed: hybrid ANN (hnsw/FAISS) for first-stage retrieval, light cross-encoder reranker applied to top-N (N=50) to limit LLM reruns. Want ability to use smaller reranker model inside Dedicated/Private (quantized INT8) to reduce cost. Caching: prefix & KV caching for repeated queries, and per-case TTL controls.

Security / compliance: must support SSO (SAML), enterprise KMS integration for keys, long-term audit logs with immutable storage (7+ years), tamper-evident logging for chain-of-custody. VPC peering or air-gapped on-prem installer acceptable. Legal quote: "We cannot expose discovery corpora outside the tenant VPC — no exceptions."

POC scope being discussed: 3-week pilot indexing ~500k representative docs, measure retrieval latency, rerank quality (MAP@k), and end-to-end cost per query with suggested batching & caching knobs. Deliverables: performance report, cost model, deployment checklist, security artifact bundle.

Stated concerns: procurement timeline (quarterly budget windows), need for an attested private installer package, and granular retention APIs for per-case retention + legal hold.

References: See linked drive deck for initial SOW and the Fireflies transcript for technical notes.
